text: よいこの　トレーナーさん　こーんにーちはー！
note: よいこ ("good children") is how Japanese children's shows address their viewers, and the stretched-out こーんにーちはー is the host's greeting that the children are expected to shout back.
claim: Japanese children's TV programmes address their young audience as よいこ (yoiko, "good children").
